doc: Menu portrait manifest (M2-MNU-301, ADR 0120). tools/portraits/render.sh renders every entry with tools/portraits/portrait_renderer.tscn on the lavapipe wrapper, one Godot process per entry. 'heroes': each hero's review stage (the characters track's AshaStage scene: model, hero materials, shader tier, face-pose table, lights) posed once per emotion tag of game/data/dialogue/emotions.json and seen through the stage's Face camera with this file's framing (camera keys override the defaults'); the nodes in hide_nodes and the sky are dropped for a transparent background. 'model', 'materials' and 'face_poses' name the sources the stage uses (tests check they agree; the PROVENANCE rows cite them). 'creatures' is the bestiary's list (M2-MNU-302), rendered by the same scene. Output: <out_dir>/<id>_<emotion>.png at 'size', drawn at size x supersample and Lanczos-reduced, after 'settle_frames' frames (deterministic: pinned wind, no TAA).
